Static HTML app. Need to build a complete playable god life simulator with:

1. Character creator — edit face, body, eyes, hair style
2. Create types of gods and races
3. Rise up rank of god
4. Board with top 20 most powerful gods

Let me design a solid single-page app with vanilla JS, no build step. Key: visual quality, playable loop, persistence.

Concept: "DIVINITY: Ascension" — a mythology god life simulator.

Flow:
- Title screen (mythic, atmospheric)
- Character creator with live SVG/Canvas character preview: face shape, body build, eyes (shape + color), hair style + color, skin tone, markings, plus god domain/type and race.
- Gameplay: life simulator with turns (Ages/Epochs). Manage divine stats: Power, Faith, Wisdom, Influence, Ambition? Actions: bless mortals, answer prayers, smite, create miracles, meditate, forge relic, etc. Mortal followers grow, faith rises. Rank progression: Demigod → Minor Spirit → Lesser Deity → Patron God → Greater God → Elder God → Primordial → Supreme. Each ascension requires thresholds and maybe a trial.
- Race/follower types: create custom races (name, traits) that worship you; each race gives bonuses.
- Rankings board: top 20 gods with power scores; your rank updates. Generated rival gods with names, domains, avatars (procedural). They grow over time too.
- Events log with mythological flavor, random events, choices.
- Visual: rich dark purple/gold/teal, glass panels, star field background, SVG character portrait built from parts, decorative frames, animated glow.

Make all in one index.html? Better split into styles.css and app.js for maintainability. Pure vanilla.

Let me carefully architect the game.

Data model:
```js
state = {
  god: { name, epithet, domain, race, appearance:{skin, faceShape, build, eyeShape, eyeColor, hairStyle, hairColor, markings, aura}, },
  stats: { power, faith, wisdom, influence, wealth? },
  followers: number,
  turn: epoch index,
  rank: index into ranks,
  xp / divinity,
  races: [custom races],
  gods: [20 rivals + player],
  log: [],
  relics: [],
  achievements: [],
  actionsUsed
}
```

Game loop: each "Aeon" turn you get action points (3) and choose actions. End turn → followers grow based on faith & domain & races, rivals gain power, random event. Power = derived from followers, faith, relics, races, rank.

Ascension: when power >= threshold for next rank, you get "Ascend" enabled. Ascension trials could be random mini-challenges? Keep simple: ascension costs divine essence and requires power threshold; triggers a cinematic overlay.

Rank list:
0 Demigod (threshold 0)
1 Divine Spark (100)
2 Minor Deity (300)
3 Patron God (700)
4 Greater Deity (1500)
5 High God (3000)
6 Elder God (6000)
7 Primordial (12000)
8 Supreme Architect (25000)

Faith action: answer prayers (+faith, +followers, costs 1 AP). Bless (+followers). Smite (+power, -followers? +influence). Miracle (costs 3 faith → big followers). Meditate (+wisdom). Forge relic (cost wisdom/power). Create race (custom race creation, costs a lot, adds followers and passive growth). Sagas etc.

Rivals board: top 20 with power scores that drift upward. Player inserted by score. Rival names generated per pantheon (Greek, Norse, Egyptian, Japanese, Hindu, Aztec, Celtic, Mesopotamian). Rival avatars: small procedural SVG sigils or emoji-ish icons? Use generated glyph circles with initials + domain icon. Better: SVG runes/sigils per domain.

Character creator: Let's make an appealing layered SVG portrait:
- Background halo/aura with domain color
- Neck & shoulders, body type variations
- Head shape (oval, angular, round, heart)
- Hair: long flowing, short, braided, mohawk, bald with crown, wild curls, topknot. Drawn as SVG paths.
- Eyes: almond, round, sharp, glowing; eye color with glow filter
- Facial features: nose, lips, brows, markings (rune, war paint, constellation, none), beard option maybe (part of "face" category), horns? accessory (crown, laurel, halo, circlet)
- Skin tones palette.

Use SVG with defs gradients. Simpler and crisper than canvas. Live updates on option change. Provide category tabs with option chips + color swatches + randomize button.

Body: build options (slender, athletic, broad, colossal) scales shoulders/torso. Since portrait is bust, show shoulders/torso size.

Race creator: choose name, trait (from list: Industrious, Arcane, Seafaring, Beastfolk, Ethereal, etc.), aesthetic color, and it adds a race card. Custom races provide passive boosts: e.g. +faith gain, +followers/turn, +power. Then convert to followers? Race creation costs 2 AP + essence. Keep up to 4 races.

Also "types of gods": choose domain (Storm, Death, Love, War, Wisdom, Nature, Sun, Moon, Trickery, Forge, Sea, Time) affecting actions bonuses and colors. Plus god archetype/type (Titan, Olympian, Aesir-like etc.)? User said "create types of gods and races". So allow custom god "type"/pantheon name creation too? I'll include: at creator, choose domain and "Divine Lineage" (types of gods): Titan, Celestial, Chthonic, Elemental, Ascended Mortal. Each gives stat modifiers. And allow custom pantheon name. Also in-game "Create Race" plus "Create Divine Order/type"? I think domain selection + lineage covers types of gods. Maybe add a "Pantheon Forge" mid-game to create a new god type? Simpler: in-game race creation and relic forging. Let me also allow creating a custom "God Type" (lineage) in creator: pick from templates OR define custom lineage with name + 2 stat leanings. That satisfies "create types of gods".

Hmm scope. Focus on polished core.

Screens:
1. Title / intro: big title "AEONFALL" or "GODHOOD". Use "ASCENDANT — A God Life Simulator". Buttons: Begin / Continue (if save), Codex?
2. Creator: 3-column: left portrait preview, center tabs (Face/Body/Eyes/Hair/Divine), right summary + "Begin your reign".
   Tabs categories: Face (skin tone, face shape, markings, beard?), Body (build, posture?), Eyes (shape, color, glow), Hair (style, color), Divine (domain, lineage, aura color, name/epithet).
   Use a scrollable panel.
3. Game: top HUD (name, rank, power, followers, faith, wisdom, influence, turn). Main: left portrait card w/ stats; center: events log + action grid; right: leaderboard top 20 (scrollable) with player highlighted. Bottom bar: End Aeon button, AP pips.
4. Modals: Ascension, Race forge, Relic forge, Event choice, Rankings full? Leaderboard is persistent right column; on mobile it becomes tab.
5. Codex/Help maybe.

Mobile responsive: use tabs for "Realm" (actions/log) and "Pantheon" (board) on narrow screens. Touch friendly.

Persistence: localStorage save/continue.

Game balance: Make progression feel achievable in ~20-30 turns. Score formula:
power = followers^0.65 * 2 + faith*1.5 + wisdom*2 + influence*1.2 + relicsBonus + raceBonus + rankBonus...
Actually each stat should matter. Let's have:
- Followers (millions? use raw with formatting)
- Faith (0-100-ish but can grow)
- Power derived.

Simplify stats: Faith, Power, Wisdom, Influence as 0-100ish resources plus Followers as number.

Action definitions:
- Answer Prayers (1 AP): +faith 6-10, +followers 3-8%, +xp.
- Perform Miracle (1 AP, costs 12 faith): +followers 15-25%, +influence 2.
- Smite the Wicked (1 AP): +power 4-7, +influence 3, -followers 2% (fear) but chance to gain.
- Grant Prophecy (1 AP, costs 8 faith): +wisdom 4, +influence 2, +faith 3.
- Meditate in the Void (1 AP): +wisdom 5, +power 2.
- Bless the Harvest (1 AP): +followers 10%, +faith 4.
- Forge Relic (2 AP, costs 25 faith + 10 power): +relic with power bonus.
- Create Race (2 AP, costs 30 faith + 15 power): opens forge.
- Sacred Festival (1 AP, costs 10 faith): +faith 12, +influence 4, +followers 5%?
Each action logs flavor text. Random events between turns with choices (2-3 options) that affect stats. Also rival gods send challenges/insults — choices.

Turn flow: AP 3 per aeon (some ranks more AP). End Aeon → resolve passive growth (followers + faith based on domain, races, influence), rivals grow, random event (50% chance?) presents modal with choices; after choice, next aeon begins. Maybe events occur at start of aeon. Let's do: End Aeon → tick → event modal if triggered → continue.

Rank ascension available when power ≥ threshold. Button glows. Ascension gives rank perks (+AP maybe every 2 ranks, +stat caps) and resets? No reset.

Leaderboard rivals: generate 19 rivals with scores spread 500-5000? Player starts at low score maybe 40 → rank near bottom or unranked ("#24"). Actually board top 20 most powerful gods. Show 20; if player outside top 20, show "You: #N" row pinned. Rivals drift upward each aeon by 1-4% + random. Let player climb over ~25 aeons.

Rival power scale: top rival ~ 18,000; bottom ~ 300. Player power starts ~ 60. Growth: followers multiplicative and stats. Need player power growth to reach 20k in reasonable turns. Let's calculate roughly.

Let me define player power score:
score = round( followers * 0.35 + faith*18 + wisdom*22 + influence*16 + relics*450 + raceBonus*300 + rank*600 )
Hmm followers maybe in thousands. Start followers 1,000? Let followers be abstract "souls": start 120? Then score ~42 + faith 10*18=180... Let's make starting stats: faith 20, power 15, wisdom 15, influence 10, followers 500.

Score = followers*0.25 + faith*20 + wisdom*20 + influence*18 + (rankIndex^2 * 250) + relicPower + racePower.

Start: 125 + 400 + 300 + 180 = 1005. Rival scores: rank 20 ~ 900, top ~ 22000. Hmm that puts player already 20ish. Fine, starts near bottom.

Each turn: followers grow maybe ×1.08-1.18 (compounding!). After 20 turns 500 × 1.12^20 ≈ 4,800. score from followers 1200. Stats faith/wisdom/influence increase ~ +2-5 per action, ~2 actions relevant per turn → +6 each; after 20 turns faith ~120 etc. score 120*20+120*22+... ~ 7000 + rank bonus. So reaching Supreme 25000 maybe ~30 turns. Reasonable. Could adjust.

Let's instead show "Divine Might" as the leaderboard metric and format numbers.

Rival drift: 2% per aeon + occasional surge; top rival grows too, so player must push. Fine.

Win condition: become Supreme Architect (rank 8) → victory screen with ending. Also can continue in "Eternal" mode. Add ending text unique to domain.

Events: write ~16 flavorful events with 2-3 choices each, some requiring stats. Also rival interactions. Each choice modifies stats via deltas and followers multiplier.

Custom races: When created, adds race object {name, trait, color, followers}. Passive: +X% follower growth, +faith per turn. Max 4 races. Trait list with fixed effects:
- Mortal (Industrious): +15% follower growth
- Beastkin (Feral): +2 power/turn
- Fae (Enchanted): +3 faith/turn
- Stoneborn (Stoic): +10% all score? or +2 wisdom/turn
- Deep Ones (Tidal): +10% followers, +1 influence
- Emberkin (Zealous): +4 faith/turn, -? 
- Starfolk (Cosmic): +3 wisdom
- Draconic (Apex): +3 power, +1 influence
Each race also has a generated sigil color & icon. Race creation requires followers? cost.

God types/lineages (choose at creation):
- Titan — +25 power start, +10% power gains, slower faith
- Celestial — +3 faith/turn, +10% faith
- Chthonic — +influence, smite stronger
- Elemental — balanced, follows domain
- Ascended — +wisdom, faster follower growth
Actually keep simple modifiers: powerMult, faithMult, followerMult, wisdomBonus.

Domains (types of gods): Storm, Death, Love, War, Wisdom, Nature, Sun, Moon, Trickery, Forge, Sea, Time. Each: primary stat bonus and action bonus. Domain colors for aura and UI accents. Domain grants a special passive.

Also allow custom domain? No, add "Custom" maybe too much. Skip.

UI design details:
- Fonts: use Google Fonts? Offline environment may block network. Use CSS font stacks with serif "Cinzel"? Not available. Better embed via Google Fonts link — screenshot might not load. Use system serif: Georgia/'Iowan Old Style' with letterspacing for headers. Could use @font-face from local? No assets. Use elegant Georgia + small caps.
- Background: gradient + starfield canvas animated (subtle), constellation lines. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- Portrait: detailed SVG with gradients, glow filters. Add subtle floating animation and particles inside halo.
- Panels: rgba dark blue-violet, thin gold border, corner ornaments via pseudo-elements.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mythology god-life-simulator web game with a character creator (face, body, eyes, hair), custom god types and races, rank ascension, and a top-20 most-powerful-gods leaderboard.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them at finish.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (max 1280px wide), read only the latest one; use full-size PNG only for fine detail.
- Must be playable now, not a mockup.

## Decisions
- Built as a zero-build vanilla ES-module static app served by existing `start.sh` (static HTML server).
- Game named **GODSPIRE**; flow: title → creator → game loop → ascension → victory.
- Character creator uses layered procedural SVG portrait with domains, lineages, starter races, skin/face/build/eyes/hair/markings/crown/complexion options.
- Mechanics: 12 domains, 5 lineages, 8 starter races, 10 actions, 3+ AP per aeon, events with choices, relic forging, custom race forge (max 4 races), 9 ranks, 24 rival gods with top-20 board.
- Balance tuned via Node simulation: optimal play reaches Supreme Architect around turn 19–21.
- LocalStorage persistence key `godspire.save.v1`; debug hook `window.godspire` for QA.

## Work State
### Completed
- `data.js`: all constants, domains, lineages, races, traits, actions, events, rivals, might/ascension/passive/event mechanics.
- `portrait.js`: full SVG portrait generator; bust proportions and robe/collar improved; hair strand overlay fixed to flowing style only.
- `index.html`: title, creator, game screens, HUD, leaderboard, mobile tabs, modal/toast roots.
- `styles.css`: complete theme, desktop + mobile responsive layouts, modals, animation, leaderboard layout fix, `[hidden]` fix, title logo fit.
- `icons.js`: custom line-icon set.
- `game.js`: complete UI controller; creator, game render, actions, turn loop, events, ascension, race forge, rival/race/relic detail modals, menu/guide, save/load, sound, starfield; syntax valid (`node --input-type=module --check`).
- App served successfully at `http://localhost:3002` via tmux session `godspire`.
- Screenshots verified: title, creator (Face + Divine), game, event modal, race forge, various portraits.
- Leaderboard text overlap fixed; rows compacted; player outside top 20 shown in footer.
- Creator neck/robe issue fixed; race forge modal visually verified.
